title: Topic 1: Introductions & Greetings - Writing
canDoStatement: Greet people, introduce yourself, use basic courtesy phrases

writingTask.writingPrompt:
STEP 1 - MODEL (student reads):
  Hello! Good morning!
  My name is Carla.
  I am fine, thank you.
  Nice to meet you!

STEP 2 - GAP-FILL the model (tap words: name / am / meet / Hello):
  ___! Good morning!            -> Hello
  My ___ is Carla.              -> name
  I ___ fine, thank you.        -> am
  Nice to ___ you!              -> meet
(auto-checked, not scored - warm-up only)

STEP 3 - WRITE YOUR OWN VERSION (typed, teacher-graded):
Prompt: Now write YOUR introduction. Change the name to YOUR name.
Minimum requirements:
  - 3 to 4 sentences
  - Use: a greeting, My name is..., I am...
minimumRequirements: Use: a greeting, My name is..., I am...
